flags_ge_0_5.text: Ta sama granica prawna, dwa projekty przebiegu. Formalna ścieżka sekwencyjna: czynności idą jedną ustaloną kolejką zatwierdzeń. Adaptacyjna ścieżka zgodna z ramami: czynności mogą iść równolegle i wracać, zanim ścieżki się połączą. Obie ścieżki pozostają w tych samych ramach uprawnień, konkurencji, etyki i dokumentacji.

The same legal boundary and two workflow designs. Formal sequential alternative: activities follow one fixed approval sequence. Adaptive compliant alternative: activities may run in parallel and return before the paths rejoin. Both paths remain within the same boundaries of authority, competition, ethics and documentation.

How the difference is calculated, without a built-in sign. The model keeps legal compliance, workflow design, contract design, execution channel and system support as separate decisions. Each one stays visible in the record.

Roles on the model and on implementation. Members work in procurement, analytics, systems, implementation, negotiation and research. The model compares two designs. The process owner still owns purpose, requirements, data, decisions, adoption and value measurement.
Purpose: Prepare the doctoral materials, keep the comparison code and records auditable, and send supervisors a bounded research proposition.
